import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPRegressor
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
X = pd.get_dummies(ok[["distance_km", "items", "hour", "courier", "weather", "shop_id"]], dtype=int)
y = ok["actual_min"]
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)


a=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),MLPRegressor(hidden_layer_sizes=(32,),max_iter=2000,random_state=0)).fit(X_train,y_train)
b=HistGradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=0).fit(X_train,y_train)
mae_mlp=round(mean_absolute_error(y_test,a.predict(X_test)),2);mae_hgb=round(mean_absolute_error(y_test,b.predict(X_test)),2)
winner="сеть" if mae_mlp<mae_hgb else "бустинг"
expect: Q1 решить regression-net. Q2 опора: формула и заготовка этого урока. Q3 бустинг ожидаю сильнее,MAE в минутах.

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

g = pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
y = g["churned"]
X = pd.get_dummies(g.drop(columns=["guest_id", "churned", "card_blocked"]), dtype=int).fillna({"avg_check": 0})
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)


from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
p=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),MLPClassifier(max_iter=300,random_state=0))
grid=GridSearchCV(p,{"mlpclassifier__hidden_layer_sizes":[(16,),(32,16)],"mlpclassifier__alpha":[.1,1.]},cv=3,scoring="roc_auc",n_jobs=1).fit(X_train,y_train)
best_params=grid.best_params_;cv_auc=round(grid.best_score_,3);test_auc=round(roc_auc_score(y_test,grid.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]),3)
hgb=HistGradientBoostingClassifier(learning_rate=.05,max_iter=300,max_depth=3,random_state=0).fit(X_train,y_train)
hgb_auc=round(roc_auc_score(y_test,hgb.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]),3)
expect: Q1 решить arch-grid. Q2 опора: формула и заготовка этого урока. Q3 4кандидата×3фолда;scaler внутри CV.
